title: London-based Applied Computing, which is developing AI models for energy operations, raised $20M led by KBR, with participation from Databricks Ventures (Tamara Djurickovic/Tech.eu)
summary: Tamara Djurickovic / Tech.eu: London-based Applied Computing, which is developing AI models for energy operations, raised $20M led by KBR, with participation from Databricks Ventures — Applied Computing has secured fresh funding to expand its AI platform for energy operations, supporting international growth …
